claims.claim_text: Hormonal changes, specifically fluctuations and estrogen that can occur during menstrual periods, pregnancy and perimenopause can trigger a migraine attack.
claims.evidence_span: Hormonal changes, specifically fluctuations and estrogen that can occur during menstrual periods, pregnancy and perimenopause can trigger a migraine attack.

claims.claim_text: Other known triggers include certain medications, drinking alcohol, especially red wine, drinking too much caffeine, stress.
claims.evidence_span: Other known triggers include certain medications, drinking alcohol, especially red wine, drinking too much caffeine, stress.

claims.claim_text: Up to 80% of people with migraines have a first-degree biological relative with the condition.
claims.evidence_span: Up to 80% of people with migraines have a first-degree biological relative with the condition.

claims.claim_text: Women are more likely than men to experience a migraine.
claims.evidence_span: Women are more likely than men to experience a migraine.

claims.claim_text: Stress is a trigger for almost 70% of people with migraine.
claims.evidence_span: Perhaps the biggest culprit of all, stress is a trigger for almost 70% of people with migraine, and one study revealed that 50-70% of people had a significant association between their daily stress level and their daily migraine activity.

claims.claim_text: Nearly half of all migraine attacks occur between 4:00am and 9:00am, putting people at a greater risk for developing a sleep disorder.
claims.evidence_span: Nearly half of all migraine attacks occur between 4:00am and 9:00am, putting people at a greater risk for developing a sleep disorder.

claims.claim_text: Alcohol, including wine and other spirits, can be a migraine trigger.
claims.evidence_span: Alcohol, including wine and other spirits, can be a migraine trigger.

claims.claim_text: Migraine attacks often occur just before or during menstruation, when estrogen levels drop.
claims.evidence_span: Migraine attacks often occur just before or during menstruation, when estrogen levels drop.

claims.claim_text: Research suggests that changes involving neurotransmitters and neuropeptides in the brain may play a role.
claims.evidence_span: Research suggests that changes involving neurotransmitters and neuropeptides in the brain may play a role.

claims.claim_text: One of these neuropeptides is calcitonin gene-related peptide, or CGRP.
claims.evidence_span: One of these neuropeptides is calcitonin gene-related peptide, or CGRP.
